summary: Iteration 3 backend testing of SHG BANK new features: (1) member self-deposits require admin approval (status=pending, createdBy=member), (2) admin deposits auto-approved, (3) savings approve/reject endpoints with auto-notifications, (4) /members/{id}/stats now exposes pendingPenalty, pendingPenaltyItems, pendingSavings with daily-accruing late-fee calc and admin exemption, (5) per-day single-instance penalty notification, (6) /notifications inbox with read/read-all/404/403. Wrote 24 new pytest tests in test_shg_v3_features.py - ALL 24 PASS (100%). Regression on v2 file: 30/31 pass; the one failure (test_balance_self) is an obsolete assertion from v2 that contradicts the new spec (self-deposits no longer add to balance until approved).

minor.issue: Approving a non-pending (already-approved) txn is silently a no-op - returns success and triggers a savings_approved notification anyway. Consider rejecting if status != 'pending'.

Admin self-deposit (user.id == input.memberId AND user.isAdmin) goes through the 'admin' branch correctly, but the check is 'user.id != input.memberId and not user.isAdmin' - works, just slightly confusing. No business impact.

EMI penalty 'double rate' logic depends on whether the EMI's due-month contribution is paid AND not the current month - rate_per_day flips between 10 and 20. Edge case: if EMI is from the current month, it always uses base rate even if contribution is also unpaid that month. Confirm intended.
Penalty notification dedupe uses regex on date prefix YYYY-MM-DD. Will fail (create duplicate) if server timezone shifts (e.g., container restarted across midnight UTC vs local). Minor.
Daily auto-creating notifications inside a GET endpoint is a side-effect on read. Better practice would be a scheduled job. Functional but unusual.
Body returns {success:true}; no echoed notification. Minor - frontend has to re-fetch list.

action_items: Update obsolete /app/backend/tests/test_shg_v2_features.py::TestMemberSelfSavings::test_balance_self - it asserts self-deposit lifts balance but new spec keeps it pending. Either change the test to deposit-via-admin or assert balance==0 with pendingAmount==250.
Optional: reject approve/reject of already-approved txn (currently silently re-approves and re-fires notification).
Optional: harden penalty notification dedupe to use date object instead of regex prefix.
Carry over from iter1/iter2: hash passwords, switch to JWT, server.py is now ~1303 lines (well past the 700-line guideline) - split into routers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew from ~1127 (iter2) to ~1303 lines (iter3). 700-line guideline broken; refactor into routers (auth, members, loans, contributions, savings, notifications, settings, stats) is becoming urgent.
Side effects (notification creation) inside a GET endpoint /stats violate REST semantics. Move to a scheduled task or to write endpoints.

Notification.message is hardcoded Hindi text. Should be i18n-keyed so frontend can render in Tamil/English per language pref (relevant since the larger feature set includes Tamil-only-for-Tamil-members).
approve/reject endpoints don't validate that current status is 'pending' - admin could 'approve' an already-approved txn and create a spurious notification.
Member.password still plaintext (carried over - security CRITICAL).
Token is still raw memberId UUID (carried over - security CRITICAL).
pendingPenalty math iterates from joiningDate every call - O(months) per stats request. Cache or compute lazily for active month only.

To force a fresh test, either change date or wipe db.notifications for the test user.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in iter3 features. All 24 new tests pass on first run. The one v2 test failure (test_balance_self) is an intentional spec change in iter3: self-deposits now require admin approval, so balance only counts approved txns. Reproduction: REKHA self-deposits ₹250 -> status='pending' -> /savings/balance/REKHA returns balance=0, pendingAmount=250, pendingCount=1. v2 test asserted balance>=250 which contradicts the new spec. Mitigation: update v2 test to assert pendingAmount instead of balance, OR deposit via admin token.
